The '''Perinn sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

{{Sec-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The map on page 202 of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' labels the sector "Perrinn."
